 Match Predictions: YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 - 1st & 2nd Semi Final - Warriors vs Boland; Lions vs Western Province - November 14th
 Match Predictions: YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 - 1st & 2nd Semi Final ©REUTERS 
 By Cricket World 
 Friday 13 November 2026 
 CSA Pro T20 Cup 
 T20 series Schedule 1st Semi-Final T20, Cape Town Sat 14 Nov Warriors 163/2 18.1 ov Boland 160/7 20 ov Warriors won by 8 wickets
 Scorecard Stats 
 2nd Semi-Final T20, Cape Town Live Lions 194/6 20 ov Western Province 56/1 6.4 ov WP need 139 runs in 13.2 remaining overs
 Lions elected to bat
 Live scores and commentary 
 Here are the Predictions for YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026, 73rd Match (1st Semi Final) - Warriors vs Boland and 74th Match (2nd Semi Final) - Lions vs Western Province, to be played on the 14th of November at the Newlands, Cape Town.
 Match Prediction - Warriors (SA) v Rocks 
 LIVE SCORES - 73rd Match (1st Semi Final) - Warriors vs Boland (Newlands, Capetown) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Newlands, Capetown (CSA T20 Challenge) - 148
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Newlands, Capetown (CSA T20 Challenge) - 139
 Current Form Warriors: 
 Warriors finished at the 1st position on Super 8's points table and they will now face Boland in the 1st Semi Final Match.
 The top run scorer for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jordan Hermann with 333 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Thomas Kaber with 15 scalps under his belt .
 Warriors have won their previous match against Titans by 7 wickets.
 Titans batted first and they posted a total of 180 for 9 in 20 overs. Titans lost the key wickets of Lhuan-dre Pretorius and Rivaldo Moonsamy quite early into the innings. After their dismissals, Sinethemba Qeshile played superbly and scored 44 runs. There were a couple of hiccups in the middle overs due to a frequent fall of wickets but Eathan Bosch had their back. He smashed 66 runs in only 37 balls to help Titans get to 180 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Warriors lost the key wicket of Sibonelo Makhanya quite early. After his dismissal, Jordan Hermann and JP King took the responsibility of taking Warriors over the line. Hermann made 95 off 54 balls while King scored 56 runs in 33 deliveries as Warriors chased the target down in the 19th over with 7 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Boland: 
 Boland finished at the 4th position on Super 8's points table and they will now face Warriors in the 1st Semi Final Match.
 The top run scorer for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Gavin Kaplan with 357 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Glenton Stuurman with 13 scalps under his belt .
 Boland have lost their previous match against Lions by 5 wickets.
 Boland batted first and they posted a total of 134 for 8 in 20 overs. They got off to a shaky start and were reduced to 55 for 4 in the 9th over itself. Ferisco Adams fought hard and scored 45 runs in 36 balls but the other batters didn't play with their full heart and Boland had to settle for an under par total of 134 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lions lost 4 early wickets and looked to be in all sorts of bother. After that phase, Mitchell van Buuren and Morteza Manack took the responsibility of taking Lions over the line. Mitchell made 60 off 48 balls while Morteza scored 25 runs in 20 balls. Both stayed not out and steered Lions to victory in the last over with 5 wickets in hand.

 Match Prediction - Lions v Western Province 
 LIVE SCORES - 74th Match (2nd Semi Final) - Lions vs Western Province (Newlands, Capetown) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Newlands, Capetown (CSA T20 Challenge) - 148
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Newlands, Capetown (CSA T20 Challenge) - 139
 Current Form Lions: 
 Lions finished at the 2nd position on Super 8's points table and they will now face Western Province in the 2nd Semi Final Match.
 The top run scorer for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Connor Esterhuizen with 291 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Nqaba Peter with 12 scalps under his belt .
 Lions have won their previous match against Boland by 5 wickets.
 Boland batted first and they posted a total of 134 for 8 in 20 overs. They got off to a shaky start and were reduced to 55 for 4 in the 9th over itself. Ferisco Adams fought hard and scored 45 runs in 36 balls but the other batters didn't play with their full heart and Boland had to settle for an under par total of 134 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lions lost 4 early wickets and looked to be in all sorts of bother. After that phase, Mitchell van Buuren and Morteza Manack took the responsibility of taking Lions over the line. Mitchell made 60 off 48 balls while Morteza scored 25 runs in 20 balls. Both stayed not out and steered Lions to victory in the last over with 5 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Western Province: 
 Western Province finished at the 3rd position on Super 8's points table and they will now face Lions in the 2nd Semi Final Match.
 The top run scorer for Western Province in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Joshua Van Heerden with 252 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Western Province in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Josh Breed with 13 scalps under his belt .
 Western Province have won their previous match against South Western Districts by 5 wickets.
 South Western Districts batted first and they were bowled out for a small total of 99. Apart from Janneman Malan, all of the top order batters failed terribly. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and South Western Districts never really looked in the game. Dane Paterson and Tshepo Moreki picked up 2 wickets each to help bowl South Western Districts out for just 99.
 During the chase, Western Province lost 2 early wickets and got off to a shaky start. After that phase, Kyle Verreynne and George Linde played with a lot of poise and intent. Kyle made 35 while Linde scored 27 runs as Western Province got over the line in the 15th over itself with 5 wickets in hand.
